prompt: App: 'SPIKE 纪律' iPhone-only (iOS 26, iPhone 17 Pro 402x874pt) crypto futures discipline app, Apple Liquid Glass controls, light appearance, bright clean white surfaces (no grey haze). Typography SF Pro + PingFang SC, tabular numbers. Candle colors: up #169873, down #D7355D. Accent #0A84FF. All numbers and coins are placeholder demo data. Chinese copy exactly as given. Bottom: a floating glass capsule tab bar with FIVE ICON-ONLY tabs (NO text labels at all), custom-drawn 24pt line icons with 2pt rounded strokes: (1) 合约 = a single candlestick with wick and an order arrow, (2) 监控 = radar sweep / pulse rings, (3) 1.618 = three horizontal levels with a golden spiral arc, (4) 持仓 = shield with a check, (5) 统计 = rising bar chart with a trend line. Active tab: icon filled in accent blue inside a lighter glass lens. Screen: 监控. Large title '监控' at top-left, NO settings button, NO subtitle or hint text. Glass segmented [模拟盘 | 报警 | 云带] with 报警 selected. Tight, dense layout with 12pt card padding and 8pt gaps. A compact hero alarm card with a soft red tint: '下沿 1.618 · 27 币', time '14:30 – 14:35', and a wrap of tappable coin chips with logos (BTC ETH SOL DOGE XRP …) — each chip opens that coin's chart. Then a dense list card of past alarms grouped by day, rows 52pt high: direction arrow icon, '上沿 1.618 · 31 币', time, chevron. No grey tags beside icons.
